title: Letter to Bishop Optimus
edition: PG 77, cols. 365-368 (Letter 80 among the letters of Cyril of Alexandria; Basil of Caesarea, Letter 260)
blurb: A letter to Bishop Optimus explaining Genesis 4:15, “Whoever kills Cain will release seven punishments,” in a fresh English translation from the Greek. The letter is Basil of Caesarea’s Letter 260; Migne’s Patrologia Graeca prints it among the letters of Cyril of Alexandria as Letter 80.
scope: The opening of the letter only (sections 1-3 of Basil’s Letter 260): the greeting and the first explanation of the sevenfold punishment. The text printed here breaks off mid-sentence.

text_history.method: A fresh English translation made from the Greek text printed in PG 77 (Letter 80 among Cyril’s letters), which is Basil of Caesarea’s Letter 260. No published English version was used for its wording.
